{{Infobox auto}}

'''Charred meat''' is meat burnt in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]]. It heals {{Hp|2}}, half as much as properly cooked meat, and has no other use.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/kiln/charred_meat.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Kilning ===
{{Recipes}}
Any raw meat (beef, chicken, porkchop, mutton or flesh) becomes charred meat in a mud kiln in 5 seconds. The recipe isn't added to the recipe book.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating charred meat takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|2}} through Regeneration IV.
